verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs describe bank-redirect authorisation flows: users are sent to their institution's login screen to grant consent (yapily-docs-29), SCA and bank redirects are handled automatically (yapily-docs-10), and data access runs on consent tokens with re-authorisation (yapily-docs-27, yapily-docs-31). That matches bank-hosted consent rather than credential scraping. However, an embedded authorisation flow also exists for some institutions (yapily-docs-30), and nothing documents OAuth/redirect coverage by institution or any retirement of legacy credential flows. Missing for 10: per-institution coverage documentation for redirect/OAuth flows, a documented deprecation or retirement path for embedded or credential-based flows, and independent corroboration.
